Rishi / team — quick technical readout and risks (high level) for the one-pager below. I'm keeping this concise for procurement; we can expand in the technical memo.

Feasibility summary (pilot constraints):
- VPC mode: Supported. We can run the control plane in a private subnet with PrivateLink for control signals and customer-hosted NAT for egress. Network envelope: need at least 2 dedicated subnets (control + inference) and an NVA for egress inspection.
- KMS: Customer-managed KMS supported, but it requires a small agents/connector deployment (1 Fargate task or small VM) to manage keys locally for disk-level encryption of model weights and temp caches. This connector requires access to the KMS endpoint and write perms to a customer-managed secrets store.
- Model packaging: For large models we recommend quantized artifacts (8-bit) for initial pilot to reduce memory footprint; this affects peak memory and GPU counts. If customer requires full fp16 artifacts, ops resourcing increases ~1.6x.
- SOC2 / logs: We can export structured audit logs to the customer's CloudWatch/Stackdriver bucket or S3 - retention and export cadence configurable. Full SOC2 report can be shared under NDA.
- Oncall: Pilot will need a named RW engineer (Soojin) + 1 ops escalation (Jasmine) and a backup (Marissa) during business hours. 24x7Critical coverage is an add-on and requires a 3-person oncall rotation (additional cost).

Blockers and exceptions:
- KMS connector: requires security review and exception for inbound maintenance ports (limited to specific IPs).
- Data residency / PHI: if Greensight requires on-prem air-gapped (no outbound), we'd need an appliance build (timeline + cost estimate available) — not supported in standard VPC flow.
- Hardware procurement lead time: if they specify GPU SKU that we don't have in region, pilot kickoff may slip 6-8 weeks.

Actionable asks for the one-pager:
1) Greensight to confirm KMS endpoint and whether they can host a small connector VM or allow Fargate task.
2) Preference: quantized (recommended) vs fp16 (higher resourcing).
3) Target pilot RPS / token budget per day.

I'll draft a one-page technical block and drop into the shared Drive link.

-Soojin

- Contract redlines: Greensight asked for a 99.9% SLA for inference latency — that will be an exception. Ops can sign 99.5% for pilot with escape clause to revisit at GA.
- Data retention: Procurement wants 365 days by default. Ops noted that 90 days is standard without extra storage charges; we can offer 365 for an add-on.
